thread:
lee: FYI opened a docs PR to tighten SOC2 audit-log language around retention, PII handling, and customer keys: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1324
anya: Quick skim. Legal wants a numeric default retention instead of vague phrasing like 'as required' or 'as needed'.
raj: Ops note: Dedicated and Private deployments support per-tenant retention. Add a migration note and a short rw-ops example for export so customers can preserve settings.
lee: Added line: "Default audit log retention: 90 days. Enterprise customers may request extended retention up to 7 years via contract." Placed migration callout linking to /dedicated/migration/retention.md.
anya: Also please include the auditor access flow: support ticket + SOW, identity-verified, time-limited access, and that auditor activity is logged. And avoid using 'HSM' alone  use 'KMS/HSM' where applicable.
lee: Updated encryption sentence to: "Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported for Private and Dedicated deployments; Hosted customers use Redwood-managed keys by default unless a customer-managed-key arrangement is specified in contract." Added auditor-access bullet.
raj: Migration snippet added suggestion: `rw-ops export-retention --tenant acme > acme-retention.yaml` and note to contact ops@redwood.ai for help.
lee: Also added a short SDK snippet showing how to disable request audit logs for dev: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, options: { audit: { enabled: false } } });
```
doc-bot: docs-ci: lint passed for PR #1324  warnings: frontmatter.productArea missing.
anya: Thanks, I'll review the final wording tomorrow and confirm legal sign-off.
